note: Five cards, one per domain, chosen to stress the card shape against content that has nothing in common. Ordering is by decay and the reason is stated on every card. NOTHING IS FILTERED — cards that rank poorly still render, with why. Two of the five have no record behind them and say so rather than showing a plausible number; that is the demonstration, not an omission.

ordering.rule: What stops being possible soonest sorts first. Domain is not a sort key.
ordering.filtering: none. Every card inside the window renders, including ones ranked low, each with its ranking reason.

outcome_types.question_task: The interview itself is the deliverable — answers captured, no document generated.
outcome_types.draft: The interview writes a document to a named path. Unsourced fields render blank and marked.
outcome_types.scheduled_send: The interview produces something addressed and dated, queued rather than sent. Sending stays a separate, deliberate act.
